Home Décor: Keep it in your living room or entrance to invite prosperity, harmony, and protection into the home.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 🔵 Lapis Lazuli Wishlist Vase (Selenite + Crystal)

Where wisdom meets clarity—introducing the Lapis Lazuli Wishlist Vase, crafted from luminous selenite and accented with natural crystal. This vase isn’t just décor; it’s a sacred tool designed to hold your deepest wishes and intentions.

• 
Lapis Lazuli chips, the crystal of Truth & Wisdom, awakens intuition, inner power, and clarity of thought.

• 
Selenite, known as the Crystal of Purification, clears negative energy and creates a serene, high-vibration aura.

• 
Together, they form a powerful wish-holder, aligning your intentions with universal energy and helping manifest clarity, success, and spiritual growth.

Write down your desires, fold them, and place them inside the vase—transforming every thought into an empowered intention. Perfect as a meditation aid, spiritual décor, or a meaningful gift, the Lapis Lazuli Wishlist Vase is a radiant reminder that your dreams deserve both light and clarity. 🌌✨

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What is the purpose of this product?

This piece is designed to support intention setting while combining clarity-driven and prosperity-focused energy in your space.

Q2. What does Lapis Lazuli represent?

Lapis Lazuli is associated with clarity, wisdom, intuition, and better decision-making.

Q3. What is the role of the Pyrite geode on top?

The Pyrite geode adds wealth and abundance energy, balancing clarity with financial growth and action.

Q4. How do I use this product?

Place it on your desk or workspace where you make decisions or focus on your goals.

Q5. Are the crystals natural?

Yes, both Lapis Lazuli and Pyrite are natural, so slight variations in texture and appearance are normal.

Q6. Does it require maintenance?

No special maintenance is needed. Keep it clean and in a meaningful, visible space.

Q7. Where should I place it for best results?

Best suited for work desks, study tables, or areas where clarity and growth matter most.
